## Official WordPress.org Plugins
- ZHS Site Audit & SEO Diagnostics: https://mdziaulhasan.com/zhs-site-audit-plugin
  - Description: Enterprise-grade 17-point automated technical health audit and SEO diagnostics engine built directly into the WordPress admin. Evaluates WCAG 2.4.1 accessibility, technical indexing, JSON-LD schema, and AI search readiness 100% locally with zero external API dependencies.
  - WordPress.org Plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/zhs-site-audit-seo-diagnostics/
- ZHS AI Alt Text Generator: https://mdziaulhasan.com/zhs-ai-alt-text-plugin
  - Description: Multi-provider AI vision suite for WordPress automating image alt text generation for WCAG accessibility and Google Image SEO. Supports OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini), Google Gemini (1.5 Flash), Anthropic Claude (3.5 Sonnet), Alibaba Qwen (VL Max), and a 100% free offline category engine with non-blocking AJAX batch processing.
  - WordPress.org Plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/zhs-ai-alt-text-generator/
